changes.to: Embodied AI's own site lists the humanoid as AIR01 ('The versatile humanoid for everyday operations') with a modular-arm, safe-by-design build, while the 6 Nov 2026 launch release names it AIR; this record and embodied-ai-air therefore describe the same robot and are a candidate for a variants merge that is left to the owner. Maker publishes no height, weight, DoF, payload, speed, runtime, compute or price, so those fields stay empty.

changes.from: Wheeled, tendon-driven humanoid for safe factory work that learns tasks from operator demonstrations; unveiled at Humanoid Europe 2026.
changes.to: The AIR01 listing on Embodied AI's site: the same Swiss wheeled humanoid introduced as AIR in November 2026 for safe, teleoperated-then-autonomous factory work.
